posts.zh:
dsh-chinese-mode 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。全局中文模式：输入框「中」字开关，开启即向任意 preset 的 system prompt 注入中文要求，锚定模式晋升后自动生效。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a102325bcdf2db4e35d9.html
posts.en:
dsh-chinese-mode is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Global Simplified-Chinese mode: a 中 switch in the input box that injects a Chinese-language requirement into every session's system prompt when enabled, skipping anchored presets' pre-promotion round.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-a102325bcdf2db4e35d9.html
